chunk_text: Should the ascendant lord be a malefic or be in the 8th, 6th or 12th, physical felicity will diminish.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: If he, however, be a benefic, there will be at all times comforts of the body.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: If the ascendant lord is in an inimical sign, there will be different diseases.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: In an angle or trine, all diseases will disappear.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: The ascendant's angles (i.e. 4th, 7th or the 10th) or its trine (5th/9th) containing a benefic is a powerful remedy for all ills related to health.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: There will not be bodily health if the ascendant or the Moon be aspected by or conjunct a malefic, being devoid of a benefic's aspect.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: A benefic in the ascendant will give a pleasing appearance, while a malefic will make one bereft of good appearance.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: Felicity of the body will be enjoyed if the ascendant is aspected by or conjunct a benefic.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: If the ascendant lord, Mercury, Jupiter or Venus be in an angle or in a trine, the native will be longlived, wealthy, intelligent and liked by the king.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House
attr_name: Benefics or Lagna Lord in Kendra or Trikona

chunk_text: Fame, wealth, abundant pleasures and comforts of the body will be acquired if the ascendant lord is in a movable sign and be aspected by a benefic planet.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House
attr_name: Ascendant Lord in Movable Sign with Benefic Aspect

chunk_text: One will be endowed with royal marks (of fortune) if Mercury, Jupiter or Venus be in the ascendant along with the Moon, or be in angle from the ascendant.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: If there be a birth in one of Aries, Taurus and Leo ascendants containing either Saturn or Mars, the birth of the child is with a coil around.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: The native, who has the Sun in a quadruped sign while others are in dual signs with strength, is born as one of the twins.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: If the Sun and the Moon join in one and the same bhava (house) and fall in one Navamsa, the native will be nurtured by 3 different mothers for the first 3 months from its birth and will later on be brought up by its father and brother.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: The learned in astrology should base the effects on the Moon also as are applicable to the ascendant.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: Head, eyes, ears, nose, temple, chin and face is the order of limbs denoted (by the various houses) when the first decanate of a sign ascends.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: In the case of the second decanate ascending, the order is : neck, shoulder, arm, side, heart, stomach and navel.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: The order for the third decanate ascending is : pelvis, anus/penis, testicles, thigh, knee, calf and foot.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House

chunk_text: The portion already risen indicates left side of the body (while the one yet to rise- i.e. invisible half-denotes right side of the body).
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 12 - Effects Of First House
